title: Push-forward of a compactly supported integer multiplicity current by a C¹ map (Simon 6.2.23–2.24, 3.3–3.9)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O) with ‖Df(y)‖ ≤ L (operator norm of fderiv ℝ f y) for every y ∈ O. Then there is a map push : 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) → 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (currents GeometricCurrentOn univ n) such that: (A) for every integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) whose support spt Y is compact and contained in O, and every integer multiplicity representation R = (M, θ, ξ) of Y (IMRep univ n, R.Represents Y): (i) push Y(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)((ω(f(x))) ∘ ΛⁿDf(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every test form ω, where (ω(f(x)) ∘ ΛⁿDf(x))(v₁, …, vₙ) = ω(f(x))(Df(x)v₁, …, Df(x)vₙ) (Lean: (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) and Hⁿ = μHE[n] — this is Simon 2.24(2), f_#Y(ω) = ∫⟨ω(f(x)), Λₙdf_x ξ(x)⟩θ dHⁿ; (ii) push Y is integer multiplicity; (iii) spt(push Y) ⊆ f(spt Y); (iv) M(push Y) ≤ Lⁿ·M(Y) (total masses, ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ n) * Y.mass); (v) if ∂Y = 0 then ∂(push Y) = 0; (vi) if f(y) = y for every y ∈ spt Y, then push Y = Y; and (B) push(Y₁ − Y₂) = push Y₁ − push Y₂ for all integer multiplicity Y₁, Y₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with compact supports contained in O.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (L : ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → (∀ y ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ L) → ∃ push : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R.Represents Y → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ O → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), push Y ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[m + 1]) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (push Y) ∧ (push Y).support ⊆ f '' Y.support ∧ (push Y).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ (m + 1)) * Y.mass ∧ (Y.boundary = 0 → (push Y).boundary = 0) ∧ ((∀ y ∈ Y.support, f y = y) → push Y = Y)) ∧ ∀ Y₁ Y₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y₂ → IsCompact Y₁.support → Y₁.support ⊆ O → IsCompact Y₂.support → Y₂.support ⊆ O → push (Y₁ - Y₂) = push Y₁ - push Y₂
